title: This week’s gift card offers with Flybuys and Everyday Rewards
body:
Weekly supermarket gift card offers are one of the easiest ways to earn bonus frequent flyer points at a lower cost. Even if you don’t have a rewards points-earning credit card, gift card offers could easily net you thousands of bonus points on things you would buy anyway.
Popular offers include 20x Flybuys or Everyday Rewards points on Apple gift cards, Uber gift cards, Ultimate gift cards and more. Here are the latest weekly gift card offers for 2026.
Week 43: supermarket gift card offers
Offer Period: 21 to 27 October 2026
10% off selected gift cards at Coles
This week, there is no bonus points offer at Coles. Instead, save 10% on Ultimate Her ($50/$100), Ultimate Him ($50), Ultimate Kids ($30/$50), Ultimate Students and Ultimate Teens gift cards.
Excludes variable load Ultimate Kids, Ultimate Her and Ultimate Him gift cards.
A limit of 5 gift cards per customer.
See the Coles catalogue for more information.
15x Everyday Rewards points on selected gift cards at Woolworths
This week, earn 15x bonus Everyday Rewards points (that’s 7.5 Qantas Points per dollar) on Xbox, TCN Shop, TCN Baby, TCN Party, TCN Him and TCN Kids ($30/$50) gift cards. If you don’t urgently need gift cards, we suggest waitikng for a 20x points offer which is the standard.
For TCN Him $100 cards, a limit of 2 cards per day, per member.
For all cards, limit of 10 cards per day, per member.
See the Woolworths catalogue for more information.
Week 42: supermarket gift card offers
Offer Period: 14-20 October 2026
20x bonus Flybuys points on selected gift cards at Coles
This week, earn 20x bonus points on Event Cinemas, Luxury Escapes, David Jones and Webjet gift cards at Coles.
A limit of 5 gift cards per customer, per day
See the Coles catalogue for more information.
20x Everyday Rewards points on selected Ultimate gift cards at Woolworths
This week, earn 20x bonus Everyday Rewards points (that’s 10 Qantas Points per dollar) on fixed denominations of Ultimate Kids, Teens, Him, Her, Baby & Mum, Students, Everyone, Home, Thank you, Celebrate and Birthday gift cards. Excludes all variable load and Ultimate Birthday $100 gift cards.
For all cards, limit of 5 cards per day, per member.
See the Woolworths catalogue for more information.

1.25 Qantas Points earned per $1 on eligible everyday purchases. 2.25 Qantas Points per $1 spent on selected Qantas products and services in Australia. 0.5 Qantas Point per $1 at government bodies in Australia. Earn 70,000 bonus Qantas Points¹ with the Qantas American Express Ultimate Card when you apply online by 17 November 2026, are approved, and spend $5,000 in the first 3 months. Plus, an additional 50,000 bonus Qantas Points when you spend a further $5,000 on eligible purchases within the first 3 months of your second year Card Membership. New Amex Card Members only. T&Cs apply.
